//: prov.outbox → provisioning.events, channel prov_outbox (db/migrations/0403). Set in
ProvisioningApplication so the defaults are right without configuration; this section
exists to override them, not to supply them.
provisioning-svc only validates tokens — iam-svc mints them (C026). Issuer must match the
one iam-svc signs with or every request is a 401.
The device PKI (T-02), in step-ca's own on-disk layout so a real step-ca can replace the
embedded issuer without moving key material. The dev compose mounts provisioning-ca-data
here and EMQX reads certs/root_ca.crt out of the same volume as its cacertfile.
CrlDistributionPoint is empty by default: EMQX refuses a certificate whose CRL it cannot
fetch, so the CDP and enable_crl_check are turned on together or not at all.

Cred.//: D6' §4.2 and D7' §4.2's Cred__RotationDays. Rotation happens 14 days before expiry.
